invariants.rationale: The method parseRegionName is called with name; if name is null, a NullPointerException may occur unless parseRegionName handles null.
String.length() is always non-negative for any non-null string.
The contract of String.isEmpty() matches name.length() == 0, validating that this relation always holds.
Trimming a string never increases its length.
Calling toLowerCase on the same input should always yield the same object equal to itself.
